answer.book: Johannes Hoornbeeck, Summa controversiarum religionis cum infidelibus, haereticis et schismaticis (1653): a Latin theological summa in eleven books, one per opposing religion or sect, preceded by a dedication to Petrus Molinaeus, commendatory verses and a dissertation on controversies, and followed by addenda and an index.
